name: missing_index
content: A slow query with a sequential scan, high rows read, and filter or join predicates may need an index.

name: lock_contention
content: A waiting PostgreSQL session and a blocking session in pg_locks indicate lock contention.

name: workload_contention
content: Many active sessions, long-running queries, or high system load can create workload contention.

name: table_bloat
content: A high dead tuple ratio and stale vacuum timestamps indicate table bloat and delayed vacuum.

name: execution_error
content: PostgreSQL execution errors should be classified from the error message and mapped to a safe corrective suggestion.
